name: Crude Language
overview: Scripture commands believers to reject crude and corrupt language, emphasizing that our speech should build up others and minister grace, not filthiness or foolish talk. The renewing of the mind enables Christians to discern and live according to God's perfect will, which includes putting away anger, malice, and filthy communication from the mouth. The inconsistency of blessing and cursing from the same mouth is condemned, urging us to speak words that reflect thanksgiving and edification rather than jesting or blasphemy.
